items.name: headpress-price
items.title: Headpress Price
items.description: Product price with the regular price struck through on sale and, only when the server sends a price preview, the Pix price and the best installment line.

items.name: headpress-search-dialog
items.title: Headpress Search Dialog
items.description: Command-palette search on useSearchBox: grouped suggestions with highlights, did-you-mean, merchandising redirects and keyboard navigation.

items.name: headpress-product-reviews
items.title: Headpress Product Reviews
items.description: Review summary with distribution bars and a sortable, filterable list with media, verified badge, store reply and optimistic helpful votes.

items.name: headpress-review-form
items.title: Headpress Review Form
items.description: Review form on useReviewForm: star rating, title and text with limits from the store config, photo and video uploads, captcha and approved/pending success.

items.name: headpress-otp-login
items.title: Headpress OTP Login
items.description: One-time code sign-in on useOtpFlow: channels from the store config, phone mask, code cells, resend countdown, attempts left, fallback channel and registration step.

items.name: headpress-pix-instructions
items.title: Headpress Pix Instructions
items.description: Pix QR code, copy-and-paste code and live expiry countdown, or the bank slip link and barcode, from PaymentInstructions.

items.name: headpress-shipping-calculator
items.title: Headpress Shipping Calculator
items.description: Product-page shipping quote on useShippingQuote: masked CEP, rates with cost and delivery window, free-shipping progress from the server.

items.name: headpress-installments
items.title: Headpress Installments
items.description: Installment table from hp.checkout.installments() in a dialog, with the server best plans highlighted.

items.name: headpress-split-payment-picker
items.title: Headpress Split Payment Picker
items.description: Split the order total between payment methods on useSplitBuilder, with local checks and the server quote of discount and charge per part.

items.name: headpress-address-form
items.title: Headpress Address Form
items.description: Brazilian address form on useAddressForm: CEP auto-fill, UF select, CPF/CNPJ and phone masks, field errors and Brazilian Market checkout fields.

items.name: headpress-cookie-consent
items.title: Headpress Cookie Consent
items.description: Cookie banner driven by the store's consent module (texts, categories, version, policy link), deciding through createConsent() from @meumouse/headpress/analytics.
